paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages reflecting the proportion of utterances assigned to each emotional label. The chart is divided into six distinct segments, each representing a different emotion: Frustration (25.1%, light blue), Neutral (23.1%, dark blue), Happiness (8.1%, red), Excitement (14.1%, orange-red), Sadness (14.7%, orange), and Anger (14.9%, yellow). The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top-left with Frustration, and their sizes visually correspond to their respective percentages. No legend is present, as labels and percentages are directly annotated on or adjacent to each slice. The largest segment is Frustration, followed closely by Neutral, while Happiness represents the smallest portion. The chart provides a clear visual summary of the relative frequency of each emotion in the dataset.
